method: Explicit visual inspection, separate from machine-checked file integrity. A pass only applies to the inspected fixture.

human_inspection.notes: Generated image was visually inspected and matched the benign fixture.
Extracted frames were visually distorted despite successful H.264 decoding.
Increasing the sampling steps to 20 did not resolve the visible distortion.
Standard decoding retained severe cyan, blue and magenta slabs with only a coarse subject shape.
Disabling dynamic VRAM did not resolve the same severe visual distortion.

First, middle and last frames show a coherent red-hulled sailboat moving over blue water, without the severe slab distortion in tiny test settings. Saturation is strong; this is a short fixture check, not a general quality benchmark.
